description: A standalone Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric mod overhauling agriculture — soil, harvests, and food. Worth growing: living soil that tires and recovers, polyculture and rotation bonuses, dietary variety, and the 3x3 scythe. Part of the Concord collection.

mods.name: Cultivation
mods.description: An agriculture overhaul for Minecraft. Living soil that tires under harvest and recovers when rested, rotation and polyculture bonuses, dietary variety, meal buffs, high-tier hoe tilling, composter Fertilizer, and a 3x3 scythe.
